requirements.text: The system shall provide a centralized database management system for the storage, management, and retrieval of watershed data.
The system shall provide a web-based client application for users to search, analyze, visualize, and download integrated watershed data.
The system shall support the storage of diverse data types including biophysical, land use, management, conservation practices, and economic data.
The system shall provide tools to translate data from location-specific formats into standardized STEWARDS formats.
The system shall maintain a metadata database compliant with the Content Standard for Digital Geospatial Metadata (FGDC-STD-001-1998).
The system shall provide a metadata input tool for creating and editing metadata in the required format.
The system shall support user authentication to manage access levels for different user classes.
The system shall provide graphical and tabular interface tools for viewing and downloading data.
The system shall support multiple levels of data aggregation for time-series data (daily, monthly, yearly).
The system shall provide web-based geographic information tools to view site-specific data within their spatial context.
The system shall show no visible deterioration in response time as the number of users increases.
Metadata query response times shall be on the order of a few seconds or less.
The system shall implement authentication using single-sign-on systems like Microsoft Active Directory.
The system shall ensure data integrity through extensive data validation and review procedures before and during data upload.
The system shall be available 24 hours per day, 7 days a week with 99% availability and a tolerance of -5%.
The user interface shall be simple, consistent, and intuitive to use without extensive training.
The system shall provide user documentation including a tutorial, help pages, FAQs, and a user manual.
The system shall use the Microsoft SQL Server database engine as the corporate standard.
The system shall be compatible with Microsoft Internet Explorer (5.0, 6.0), Netscape (4.7, 6, 7), and FireFox browsers.
The system shall perform full backups of all user and application data on a week-nightly basis.
